newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest bourse ends week in bullish mood.
newsitem.headline: Budapest bourse ends week in bullish mood.

text.p: Hungarian share prices closed mostly higher on the Budapest Stock Exchange on Friday, buoyed by revived foreign activity, traders said.
The BUX index closed at 3,547.37 points, up 76.12.
"Warsaw also leapt today, so foreign investors seem to have geared up," Zsolt Madacsi of Postabank Securities said.
Investors' uncertainties eased after the Fed left its rates unchanged on Tuesday and now they might have resumed purchases on the central European emerging markets, traders said.
Chemical company TVK remained steady on Friday at 1,340 forints, but grabbed attention with a huge deal for 232,000 shares at the daily peak of 1,350 forints/share price.
Meeting traders' earlier expectations the pharmacuetical shares were strong gainers, although all of them closed below their daily peaks.
Human rose to a new high of 2,850 forints, but descended to end at 2,790, up 170.
Rebounding Richter ended at 8,195 forints, up 345, but below the daily peak of 8,200 forints.
Egis, after retreated from a daily high of 11,050 forints to end at 10,950, up 310.

Hotelier company Danubius which today signs an the agreement with the country's privatisation agency APV Rt about the purchase of an 85 percent stake in Hungaria Szalloda Rt hotel chain, continued to strengthen and reached a new high.
However, like many other share, Danubius also came off the new record of 3,165 forints to end at 3,150, up 50.
